name: @openpalm/client
description: OpenPalm client app — the unprivileged chat/connections static SPA (plan ui-runtime-modes-plan.md §6.11). Talks directly to per-connection OpenCode/guardian base URLs; connections persist in IndexedDB. §8.10 rule: this package NEVER depends on @openpalm/lib and never holds host credentials; runtime dependencies stay empty (the adapter-static build is fully self-contained, and bin/serve.mjs is zero-dependency) — document any exception here.

scripts.build: svelte-kit sync && vite build && node scripts/stamp-version.mjs
